title: Hold an authority for aquaculture
what: Carry out prescribed aquaculture development (such as farming fish or prawns in ponds or cages) only while holding an aquaculture authority.

sources.title: Fisheries Act 1994 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out prescribed aquaculture development unless the person holds an aquaculture authority
